verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online ships built-in automation like automatic transaction rules and automated payment/invoice reminders, and its MCP server exposes CRUD and reporting tools for AI agents, but there is no documented capability for an AI-native user to schedule or configure recurring jobs/workflows programmatically via the API or MCP server. missing for 10: explicit recurring-job/workflow scheduling API or MCP tool, agent-triggered cron-like automation, confirmation that Intuit Intelligence or MCP tools can set up standing recurring tasks.
